name: custom-system-builder
description: Build your custom system without any line of code !
author: LinkedFluuuush

scripts.build: npm run format && npm run lint && npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run copy-files
scripts.build-release: npm run clean && npm run compile-release && npm run copy-files
scripts.copy-files: cp -R ./src/lib ./dist && cp -R ./src/css ./dist && cp -R ./src/templates ./dist && cp -R ./src/lang ./dist && cp -R ./src/img ./dist && cp ./system.json ./dist
scripts.package: npm run build-release && mkdir -p out && (cd dist/; zip -r ../out/custom-system-builder.zip ./; cp ./system.json ../out)
scripts.test: ./run-foundry.sh run -v 11 -s autoTest --wait-for-start; tree tests/expected_data/screenshots/base/ -dfi --noreport | sed 's@tests/expected_data/screenshots/base/@@' | tail -n +2 | xargs -I{} mkdir -p "tests/output/{}"; codeceptjs run --steps --reporter mochawesome;
scripts.test-debug: ./run-foundry.sh run -v 11 -s autoTest --wait-for-start; tree tests/expected_data/screenshots/base/ -dfi --noreport | sed 's@tests/expected_data/screenshots/base/@@' | tail -n +2 | xargs -I{} mkdir -p "tests/output/{}"; codeceptjs run --steps --grep "@only";
scripts.doRelease: git checkout beta && git merge develop && git checkout main && git merge beta && git tag
